gloss_en: "Tzur levavi" — the phrase "Rock of my heart" from Psalms 73:26 (צוּר from the root meaning rock/stone, not צור as besiege or form), denoting the heart in its aspect of rock/stone: read as the Supernal Heart that is the rock-source of speech, and as the stony heart that must be turned to water (per "who turns the rock into a pool of water")
